bindings.validation: custom personal-library footprint; pads 1-2 map one-to-one; both lands are 0.30 x 0.50 mm with 0.70 mm center pitch, verified in the footprint manager against the TI DPY0002A example board layout

custom personal-library footprint imported through a KiCad 5 PCB wrapper from the official GCT/KiCad land pattern; all 17 schematic pin names map one-to-one to A1, A4-A9, A12, B1, B4-B9, B12, and SH; A1/B12 and A4/B9 remain separate coincident pads, while four physical shell pads share SH. The importer represents the top signal lands as numbered polygon pads and the footprint manager reports their nominal size as 0.000 x 0.000 mil, so PCB DRC and Gerber inspection remain mandatory.

custom personal-library footprint imported through a minimal KiCad 5 PCB wrapper from the Johanson circular/thin-edge mounting drawing; footprint-manager pad list shows separate pads 1-4, each 39.370 x 23.620 mil (1.00 x 0.60 mm), and the ANT1 symbol pins FEED/GND/GND/TUNE-GND map one-to-one to pads 1/2/3/4. The source wrapper places pad centers at X +/-1.50 mm and Y +/-0.65 mm. PCB layout must still enforce an approximately 8.0 x 3.4 mm all-layer copper and component clearance area and must be RF-tuned in the final pen enclosure.

custom personal-library direct-wire footprint; pads 1-3 are 1.50 x 2.00 mm SMD lands on 1.80 mm pitch for the protected cell PACK+, PACK-, and CELL_NTC leads. Initial mechanical assumption is 30-32 AWG wire with strain relief supplied by the 3D-printed enclosure. Imported rectangular pads are dimensioned by the version-controlled source wrapper; verify their rendered geometry in PCB/Gerber before release.

custom personal-library 2 x 3 pogo footprint; six round 1.00 mm SMD pads on 1.27 mm X/Y pitch map one-to-one to GND, 3V3, EN, BOOT, UART_TX, and UART_RX. The programming jig must be built to the same pitch and orientation before production release.

custom personal-library direct-wire footprint; two 1.50 x 2.00 mm SMD lands on 2.00 mm pitch map to VSYS and PWR_SW_ON. Initial mechanical assumption is 30-32 AWG wire with strain relief supplied by the 3D-printed enclosure. Imported rectangular pads are dimensioned by the version-controlled source wrapper; verify their rendered geometry in PCB/Gerber before release.
pads 1-57 map one-to-one; 7 x 7 mm LGA, 0.4 mm perimeter pitch, and 4.0 x 4.0 mm GND pad 57 were checked in the footprint manager
pads 1-8 plus EP9; pin order cross-checked against MLX90393 datasheet

custom personal-library footprint; pads 1-16 plus exposed pad 17 map one-to-one; 0.24 x 0.60 mm peripheral lands at 0.50 mm pitch and 1.68 x 1.68 mm exposed pad were checked in the footprint manager; optional thermal vias omitted
pads 1-7 cross-checked against TLV75533 DRV package
pads 1-6 cross-checked against TLV6700 DSE package

save_boundary: All 60 components have a bound footprint in the online editor. The final footprint-manager recount showed 60 component rows and zero unbound rows. The online project and all five schematic pages showed no unsaved marker after saving. The three project-specific footprints J2, J3, and SW1 were imported into the personal library and bound; the passive and IC assignments were also re-applied after the live editor showed that an earlier assumed binding state had not persisted.
erc_boundary: In 嘉立创EDA Standard Edition 6.5.51, the schematic Design Manager was manually refreshed after the final bindings. It showed 60 components and 37 / 37 networks; expanding the network list showed all 37 named networks with no exclamation mark or error description. This is the Standard Edition integrated schematic ERC/connectivity check, not PCB DRC and not hardware validation.
local_source_boundary: The original generated SCH-A2 source files retain their empty package fields. A separate five-sheet export, SCH_round_sensor_SCH_A2_bound60_2026-09-15.json, now preserves the saved online schematic and all 60 nonempty package assignments. Its SHA-256 is 925871e6dac455a309294df3c2a8e8d069732dccfcdd550e12e8e1d3cec072bf. Use that export to recover the bound online version.
pcb_conversion_boundary: The saved online schematic successfully converted to PCB_round_sensor_SCH_A2 with 60 footprints and 37 networks. The saved initial PCB has a provisional 30 mm circular outline, the default two copper layers, and components still staged outside the outline. Native DRC was run and returned 160 unfinished-connection entries; no routing or minimum-diameter conclusion is claimed. A local copy is PCB_round_sensor_SCH_A2_initial_2026-09-15.json.
release_boundary: Footprint binding and the Standard Edition integrated schematic ERC/connectivity gate are complete. This does not authorize manufacturing or freeze the board diameter. After PCB conversion, place the actual footprints on a provisional circular outline, verify J1/J2/SW1 imported polygon-pad geometry with native DRC and Gerber inspection, implement ANT1's approximately 8.0 x 3.4 mm all-layer RF clearance, confirm the J3 pogo-jig orientation and the wire strain-relief mechanics, and tune the RF matching network in the final pen enclosure.
